full_prompt_en: A square oil painting looks down a narrow urban canal between closely packed old buildings at rainy dusk. The viewpoint is near the water at the mouth of the passage. Dark masonry and small balconies rise along the left edge, while a pale ocher building with many small windows occupies the right middle ground. A tall distant tower stands near the center of the vanishing point, softened by gray-blue atmosphere. Several small boats are tied beside wooden posts and platforms along the right bank; their pale covers and dark hulls sit just above the water. A narrow waterside walkway runs along the left wall, with a few warm lamps set beneath deep shadow. One tiny pedestrian is visible farther down near the left bank. The canal fills the lower half with broken reflections. Ocher and amber lights form long fragmented streaks among green, slate blue, and gray patches, while darker near water holds larger almost black strokes. The buildings are painted with uneven surfaces: chipped plaster, damp stone, small shutters, iron balcony rails, and plants on upper ledges. A full leafy mass softens the right edge beyond the pale facade. The sky is a pale overcast blue-gray, giving diffuse cool light, but the lamps supply concentrated points of warmth at water level. Paint is laid in short, loose yet deliberate strokes; near walls have thick texture, while the tower and far openings lose detail in atmospheric blur. Vertical buildings frame a tight central route, and the repeated lamp reflections lead the eye inward. The overall composition balances the cool damp canal and shadowed facades with a few inviting amber windows, making the scene quiet, lived-in, and gently luminous.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画从雨暮中紧挨的旧建筑之间望入一条狭窄城市运河。视点靠近通道入口的水面。深色石墙与小阳台沿左边缘升起，右侧中景则是一幢有许多小窗的浅赭色建筑。一座高远塔位于接近中央消失点处，被灰蓝空气柔化。几艘小船系在右岸木桩和平台旁，浅色船盖与深色船身刚好浮在水面上。左墙旁有一条窄水边步道，深影下点着几盏暖灯。更远处左岸附近可见一名很小的行人。运河占据下半幅，承载破碎倒影。赭黄与琥珀灯光在绿、石板蓝和灰色水斑间拉成长而断续的光痕，近处更暗的水由较大、近黑笔触构成。建筑表面不平整：剥落灰泥、潮湿石块、小百叶、铁阳台栏杆和高处边缘的植物都可见。右侧浅色立面后面一团饱满叶影软化边缘。天空浅淡多云，提供冷色漫射光，灯则在水边给予集中的暖点。颜料以短小、松而有意的笔触铺出；近墙肌理厚，远塔与通道开口在空气模糊里失去细节。竖向建筑框住紧窄中心路径，重复的灯影把视线往里引。整体构图以冷湿运河与阴影立面对着几处诱人的琥珀色窗光，让场景安静、有人居住且轻轻发亮。
style_prompt_en: Oil painting builds a damp atmospheric scene through short broken strokes, textured near surfaces, and soft distant loss of detail. Cool slate blue, green-gray, and charcoal cover the broad shadow and reflective areas; small amber and ocher lights punctuate them. Vertical masses enclose a narrow central passage, while elongated fragmented highlights repeat below to pull the eye inward. Harder near edges break into painterly patches, and far geometry dissolves into a cool haze. Overcast ambient light keeps the large forms subdued, allowing localized warm points to carry the visual focus. The surface remains visibly worked rather than polished, with layered scumbles and uneven color boundaries creating a quiet luminous depth.
style_prompt_zh: 油画用短而断续的笔触、有肌理的近处表面和远方逐渐失细节的柔化建立潮湿空气感。冷石板蓝、绿灰与炭色覆盖宽阔阴影和反光区域，少量琥珀与赭黄光点刺入其间。竖向大块围合狭窄中央通道，下方拉长而破碎的亮痕重复，把视线往里引。较硬近边裂成绘画色斑，远处几何形溶进冷雾。阴天环境光让大形低调，使局部暖点承担视觉焦点。表面保持可见加工痕而非磨亮，层层揉擦与不匀色界造出安静发光的纵深。
theme_en: A narrow canal between weathered buildings at rainy dusk
theme_zh: 雨暮时分一条狭窄运河穿过风化建筑之间
name: Dmitri Danish
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
